topic: Perfect vision? Why still get a yearly eye test

youtube.title: Perfect vision? Still get an eye test! Myth or fact 👁️ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Perfect vision? You still need an eye test. Myth or fact? 👁️
பார்வை நன்றாக இருந்தாலும் கண் பரிசோதனை அவசியம்!

• Clear sight is only part of the story. Eye pressure, the optic nerve and the retina need a proper check.
• Studies show about half of people with glaucoma do not know they have it.
• Power changes slowly; children grow; after 40, near focus changes.
• Diabetes and high BP can affect the retina before you notice anything.
• See an eye specialist the same day for sudden blur, eye pain or a dark shadow.
• Make a yearly family eye test your new-year habit.
